component.name: COSMIC Radio
component.summary: Internet radio streaming applet for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: A minimalist COSMIC panel applet for streaming internet radio stations, with station management, now-playing metadata with a scrolling marquee, volume control, PLS playlist support, album artwork caching, and MPRIS2 integration for other desktop applications.

ul.li: Now-playing metadata display with scrolling marquee
Volume control from the panel popup
PLS playlist support and "Play from URL"
MPRIS2 integration: now-playing metadata and media controls for other desktop applications

screenshot.caption: The COSMIC Radio panel popup showing stations and now-playing information

description.p: Packaging fixes for Pop Store submission

ul.li: Correct homepage URL and AppStream metadata fixes
Now-playing metadata (title, artist, stream URL, artwork) over MPRIS2
Media controls from external clients (play, pause, stop, play-pause)
Internet radio streaming applet for the COSMIC desktop
Now-playing metadata display and artwork caching
PLS playlist support and "Play from URL" feature
